title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Connection Reuse and Resumption Tickets Work Item
summary: Add client-side idle-timeout reuse gating, resumption ticket single-use tracking, connectivity-change detection, address validation token policy, and server-side resumption ticket lifetime and anti-replay options.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqClient.IdleTimeoutMargin reuse gating against the advertised QUIC idle timeout.
- Cross-reference edns-tcp-keepalive prohibition to slice 0008 (ARC/WI/VER-0008).
- Add DoqClient.IsTicketUsed flag set after first QueryAsync; reject subsequent use.
- Add DoqClient.ConnectivityId and PriorConnectivityId for connectivity-change detection.
- Add DoqClient.UseAddressValidationWithResumptionOnly policy flag (default true).
- Add DoqServerOptions.ResumptionTicketLifetime (default 6 hours).
- Add DoqServerOptions.EnableAntiReplay (default true).
- Add focused unit tests for idle-timeout reuse gating, ticket tracking, connectivity checks, and options defaults.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
completion_notes: All 8 REQs are now traced and verified. Policy-layer enforcement is in place for idle-timeout reuse gating, ticket single-use, connectivity changes, address validation, ticket lifetime, and anti-replay.
